title: EUREKA HYBRID04 SIX PAGES — MIDI+FUNC HELD INPUT FIX
author: analoglav
description: Based on user-tested MC78 and PG79 source. Corrects a provable page-key guard defect: with MIDI+FUNC physically held, Digitone page-key events carry FUNC flag bit2, which PG79 rejected. When armed by MIDI+FUNC, TRIG/SYN1/SYN2/FLTR/AMP/LFO each open its custom 128x64 parameter page even while both modifier keys remain held, and second press returns to the original animation. Standalone FUNC+PAGE still passes through to stock. The successful MC78 isolated MIDI+YES stock MUTE fix, original stock TRIG1..16, 576 frames, random scenes, and Granular0.5 are unchanged. Source-only, unbuilt, device verification pending.
